_note: Manual keys read from neurometabench merged annotation note keys (data/nimads/emotion_regulation_2022/merged/nimads_annotation.json; 88 studies, 248 notes). The auto side is an identity mapping and is LIVE: v2-annotation-only.yaml defines annotations named exactly decrease/increase/maintain/reappraisal. Those criteria were written from the source paper's full text and its supplementary Table S1, and were reviewed and approved by the project author on 2026-08-27. They get ported into v2-allstudies.yaml once trialled -- v2, not v3, because v3-allstudies regressed (full-text TP 42 -> 19). CORRECTED 2026-11-06: this note previously claimed two gold-file defects -- that Decrease.txt held the reappraisal union (152 vs an expected 130) and that Maintain.txt was missing ~97 of 104 Look experiments. Neither is borne out by the committed annotation. decrease holds 128 experiments and is a PERFECT SUBSET of reappraisal's 154 (all 128 shared, zero decrease-only, Jaccard 0.831), so the r=0.970 between their gold maps is nested sets rather than a wrong file; whether the nesting is correct is a question about the source design, where reappraisal is a strategy and decrease a regulation goal. maintain holds 94 experiments, so ~10 are unaccounted for against an expected 104, not ~97. decrease is still excluded from the surface figure, because showing it beside reappraisal would display 128 shared experiments twice. This _note key is ignored by scripts/nmb_mapping.py, which reads only annotation_mappings when present.
